propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short (≤3 line) JSON reminder when commands invoke grep-family tools (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep), guiding agents toward Serena's symbol tools while noting legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers).
The hook trigger must use plain string matching on command text without pattern classification or path heuristics, accepting false positives to avoid silent misses.
The hook must be non-blocking: it informs via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext JSON, omits permissionDecision entirely, never exits non-zero, and allows the grep command to execute normally.

The hook implementation spans .claude/settings.json (PreToolUse entry), scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py (tracked script body), and docs/ (one-line reference), and must merge with story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting without overwriting it.

Automated tests must verify the hook fires on grep -rn and rg commands, does not fire on non-grep commands, executes the hook against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope, and asserts JSON output contains additionalContext with no permissionDecision.
The hook must handle malformed input gracefully (empty stdin, absent command, non-JSON stdin) without exiting non-zero or emitting permissionDecision.
